stem: Which ending result or final point follows “The past is not empty material for the present.”?
options: I still miss home, but I am beginning to understand why people like camp.
People still need to ask why it keeps becoming full and what should change.
It belongs, in different ways, to people who lived and people who still remember them.
Sometimes it is a sign that people care about different parts of the same story.
